name: shell-sharp-corners
why: An L block 20 x 20, legs 5, 10 tall, shelled by 1 with sharp corners: the cavity is the L stepped in by 1 with its inside corner square, 99 mm2 over 8 mm, so 1750 - 792 = 958.000 mm3 by closed form, 16 planar faces; the round default leaves 956.283 and 17 faces, which is 0.18 % apart, more than this corpus's tolerance, so a Fusion shell recreated here needs the sharp join. The cavity's L-shaped ceiling is one unsupported face and no bridge: its middle falls in the bay beside it, which the overhang probe's rule excludes.
